questions.q: Why does the Key Account Layout exist as a separate layout from the Restaurant Account Layout?
options: Salesforce requires a unique layout per Record Type regardless of content
Restaurant accounts cannot have a Service Contract related list at all
It surfaces related Service Contracts and Number of Kitchen Locations prominently, since Hotel & Hospitality and Healthcare & Institutional are Priya Nair's multi-location accounts
The Key Account Layout is identical to the Standard Layout, just renamed
questions.explain: The lesson explains the Key Account Layout exists specifically to surface Service Contracts and location count for the large, multi-location accounts Priya Nair manages -- different information matters than for a single-location restaurant.

questions.q: What does the Path component at the top of the Opportunity layout visually represent?
options: The list of products attached to the Opportunity
A visual tracker showing progress through Cascade's stages, from Qualifying to Closed Won
The Account's billing address history
A chart of the sales team's monthly quota attainment
questions.explain: The lesson describes the Path as a visual Lightning component showing progress through Opportunity Stage -- from Qualifying through Closed Won -- placed at the top of the layout.

questions.q: Which two Chapter 1 Definition of Done requirements does this lesson complete?
options: Validation rules on two objects, and an approval process
Roles, profiles, and sharing rules enforcing least privilege
Reports organized into folders, plus an executive dashboard
Page layouts and at least one Lightning App Page built for how the company's own users actually work
questions.explain: The lesson states directly that building layouts matched to real Record Types and a Lightning App Page matched to a real workflow checks off the 'page layouts and Lightning App Page' line from Lesson 1's Definition of Done.

questions.q: In the Sales Workspace Lightning App Page, what sits in the right column alongside the related Contacts list?
options: A Chatter feed and a calendar component
An Account highlights panel (Business Segment, Primary Equipment Interest) and the related Installation Project
A list of all open Leads company-wide
The full Service Contract object list view
questions.explain: The lesson's layout table places an Account highlights panel at the top of the right column, related Contacts in the middle, and the related Installation Project at the bottom.

questions.q: Why do the Service and Customer Success profiles keep the plain, auto-generated Opportunity page instead of the Sales Workspace?
options: Because those profiles are not allowed to view Opportunities at all
Because Lightning App Pages can only be activated for the System Administrator profile
Because the Sales Workspace requires a paid add-on license
Because the Sales Workspace is purpose-built for how Tom Baptiste and Priya Nair actually work a deal, not for Service or Customer Success workflows
questions.explain: The lesson explains the Sales Workspace is activated specifically for Sales Rep and Sales Manager profiles since it's built around how sales reps work a deal -- Service and Customer Success keep the default page instead.
